_comment: Target-conditioned ligand generation against acaricide-relevant targets curated in data/acaricide/targets.csv (see code/data_process/select_acaricide_targets.py). Uses the genetic_algorithm strategy, which needs no generator backend/weights -- only seed_smiles and a trained DTIAM predictor.
_targets_comment: All 53 target_chembl_id values from data/acaricide/targets.csv (see its moa_class column for which MOA each one belongs to). score_and_rank returns top_k per target when multiple targets are present, so this yields a ranked ligand list for each of the 53 targets, not one blended global list.
_dtiam_model_paths_comment: Populate after running code/train_models.sh (or code/train_dtiam_models.py). ESM-2 generalizes across proteins, so a predictor trained on the davis/yamanishi benchmark data can score these acaricide targets without retraining. Pointing at fold_0 specifically because this model was trained via train_dtiam_models.py's default k-fold path (before train_models.sh was fixed to use --ensemble-only), which only saves per-fold predictors under models/dta_davis/fold_N/, not a top-level models/dta_davis/predictor.pkl. fold_0 was trained on ~80% of davis's data -- fine for getting real results now; swap this back to "models/dta_davis" once you rerun code/train_models.sh with the --ensemble-only fix for a predictor trained on 100% of the data.
